newsitem.title: USA: Dow extends gains, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow extends gains, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips pushed to session highs in afternoon trading on Thursday, triggering program trading curbs on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Dow industrials gained 52 points to 7895, prompting the NYSE to impose index-arbitrage curbs at 1418 EDT/1818 GMT.
Cyclical issues boosted the Dow, keeping with a recent trend. International Paper Co rose 2-7/8 to 57-13/16 and Caterpillar Inc gained 1-7/8 to 112-9/16.
Market breadth improved, with NYSE advancing issues outnumbering decliners by more than three-to-two.
